components.label: Plan literature queries
components.description: Expands the accepted name, synonyms, genus and plant part into search queries.

components.label: Add audited studies
components.description: Always includes the audited harvest-study papers for this species.

components.label: Search OpenAlex
components.description: Scholarly works index; abstracts rebuilt from the inverted index.

components.label: Search Europe PMC
components.description: Life-science literature; falls back to OpenAlex if the service is down.

components.label: Merge and de-duplicate
components.description: Merges every source, removes duplicates by DOI or title, keeps records that have abstracts.

components.label: JEV reads each paper
components.description: JEV classifies every record with keyword rules alongside; disagreements go to a person. Remove it to use rules only.

components.label: Extract quoted findings
components.description: Groq (Gemini fallback) extracts findings; each must quote the abstract word for word.

components.label: Second-model check
components.description: A second model (Gemini first) checks that each quote supports its claim; unsupported claims are removed.

components.label: Matrix sensitivity (bootstrap)
components.description: 2,000-resample bootstrap over every QC-passing matrix: how much growth depends on the harvested process.

components.label: Year-to-year variation
components.description: Simulates 20,000 years of randomly drawn good and bad years for harvested vs unharvested matrices.

components.label: Check against audited studies
components.description: Flags contradictions, single-study bases, few matrices and transferred evidence.

components.label: JEV routes to review
components.description: JEV decides which findings need expert review; it can only make routing stricter than the rules.

components.label: CITES trade listing
components.description: Species+ listing and appendix. CITES covers international trade, not local harvest permission.

components.label: What the data allows
components.description: The eligibility rules: which analyses the evidence supports for this species, and why.

components.label: Harvested vs control plots
components.description: Long-run growth of harvested and unharvested populations in each audited harvest study.

components.label: Recovery and rest years
components.description: One harvest year then rest years, from a published harvested/control matrix pair. Illustration, not a schedule.

components.label: Harvest methods for this part
components.description: Which life process each method touches and what to measure locally.

components.label: Look-alikes and timing data
components.description: Known synonyms or look-alikes to rule out, growth form, and whether flowering-time data exist.

components.label: What to measure next
components.description: The evidence planner: the cheapest set of field work that unlocks the most decisions for this species.
